title: Bhajan Jammin
summary: The Rotary Club of Mumbai Crown hosted a Bhajan Jamming Event on 26th July 2026 at the Rustomjee Crown Ballroom, Gokhale Road, Prabhadevi.
description: The Rotary Club of Mumbai Crown hosted a Bhajan Jamming Event on 26th July 2026 at the Rustomjee Crown Ballroom, Gokhale Road, Prabhadevi. The event witnessed enthusiastic participation from 75 members, family members, and friends, who came together to enjoy an evening of devotional music, singing, and fellowship. The event created a joyful and spiritual atmosphere, fostering camaraderie and strengthening the bond among members and their families.
